name: Clipboard Permission & Leakage Test — Browser Diagnostic
desc: See whether your browser lets a page read the clipboard, silently or with a prompt. Explains the clipboard permission model and real hijacking risks. Runs locally.

name: EXIF & GPS Metadata Stripper — Offline Photo Cleaner
desc: Inspect the EXIF and GPS metadata in a photo, then export a copy with all of it removed by canvas re-encoding. Runs in your browser; the image is never uploaded.

name: GPC & Do Not Track Signal Inspector — What Your Browser Sends
desc: Check whether your browser sends Global Privacy Control or Do Not Track, what each signal means, and where GPC has legal force. Runs locally; nothing is uploaded.

name: Media Container Tag Inspector — MP4, MP3, MKV Metadata
desc: Read the metadata inside audio and video files: ID3 tags, MP4 and MOV boxes, Matroska EBML elements, GPS coordinates and device details. Runs locally; nothing is uploaded.

name: Tor v3 Onion Address Validator — SHA3 Checksum Check
desc: Validate a Tor v3 onion address: base32 decode, ed25519 key extraction and SHA3-256 checksum verification. No network connection is made and nothing is uploaded.

name: PDF Metadata Redactor & Sanitizer
desc: Inspect, extract, and permanently sanitize hidden PDF metadata dictionaries (/Info, /Metadata, XMP XML, Dublin Core) directly inside local browser memory. 100% private, zero network egress.

name: Canvas Steganography Tool
desc: Conceal and recover covert text messages within image pixel Least Significant Bits (LSB) entirely inside browser RAM. Zero network egress, zero logs, lossless carrier export.

name: Browser Storage Cleaner & Persistence Auditor
desc: Enumerate, inspect, and purge client-side browser storage vectors locally in your browser memory. Audit LocalStorage, SessionStorage, IndexedDB databases, Cache API entries, and storage quotas with zero telemetry.

name: URL Tracking Parameter Stripper & Privacy Sanitizer
desc: Strip marketing trackers, telemetry tokens, click IDs (fbclid, gclid, utm_*), and referral parameters locally in browser memory. Zero tracking, zero network egress.
